# Green Health

> AI-powered crop disease detection for farmers: scan a leaf photo or describe symptoms and get an instant diagnosis, treatment plan and prevention guide.

Green Health combines vision-based crop scanning with specialist AI agronomy agents
(plant pathology, agronomy, entomology, soil and nutrition) and a curated pathology
index of common crop diseases, their symptoms and their treatments.

## Pages

- [Home](/): AI crop scanner, specialist agents, pathology index, pricing and contact details.
